title: Restricted Standard-WOFOST Two-Phase Crop-Window Composition
goal: Compose the already-qualified F-WOF26, F-WOF28, F-WOF31 and F-WOF32 seams into one transaction-neutral two-phase standard-WOFOST crop-window API without adding scheduler, commit authority, solver calls or accepted-aggregate accumulation to the crop kernel.
qualified_component_chain: F-WOF26: candidate-local one-day structural prepare/finalize and GLAIEXP compatibility memory
F-WOF28: compact read-only DVS/WRT/WST/WSO/WLV/LAI/LAIEXP state view
F-WOF30: shared immutable restricted rate parameter bundle
F-WOF31: pure phase-A actual PGASS provider
F-WOF32: pure phase-B rate-packet provider with runtime accepted-window lineage hold

order: for active crop only: F-WOF28 assemble one immutable semantic rate-state snapshot
translate explicit forcing plus candidate-local TMNR to F-WOF31 forcing
freeze the phase-B TAV/DAYLP forcing in the trial-local context
phase_A_begin.inactive_crop: successful no-op context; active-only canopy and rate parameters are not inspected

inputs: same shared immutable rate parameter bundle
frozen semantic wofost_accepted_window_aggregates_t supplied by runtime
order: F-WOF32 finalize rate packet from the exact phase-A state snapshot and frozen phase-B forcing
F-WOF26 finalize structural candidate from the prepared candidate, same accepted aggregates and generated packet
phase_B_complete.on_failure: returned candidate is reset to the phase-A prepared candidate and must not represent a partially applied structural trial

trial_context_contract.ownership: worker/job-local crop-window trial context, never persistent column state
stores: F-WOF26 prepared candidate containing candidate-local Tmin history
trial_context_contract.replay: same committed state + same forcing + same immutable parameters yields bitwise identical begin context; same context + same frozen accepted aggregates yields bitwise identical candidate, packet and diagnostics

accepted_window_provenance_hold.reason: moving transaction lineage checks or solver accumulation into crop composition would violate kernel/runtime separation

temporal_contract.kernel_time: generic t0,t1 remains outside this process-specific seam
temporal_contract.admitted_process_event: exactly one qualified crop day as already required by F-WOF26
temporal_contract.Richards_substeps: not visible to F-WOF33 and must not invoke crop phase-B or structural evolution

parameter_ownership.SSA_SPA: explicit immutable view-assembly parameters; not copied into persistent crop state
parameter_ownership.DVSEND_SPAN: F-WOF26 structural integrator parameters supplied at complete phase
parameter_ownership.rate_parameters: shared immutable F-WOF30 bundle passed by intent(in) to begin and complete; not copied into trial context

not_qualified: runtime production accumulation and provenance proof for IQROT/IPTRA
runtime scheduling of exactly one WOFOST crop event per admitted crop day
end-to-end legacy scientific qualification over a full historical B1.10 crop trajectory
arbitrary subdaily or multi-day WOFOST evolution calls
